title: Regional Residency Orchestrator with Evidence Packaging for Hosted API
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Customers in regulated industries need a single, auditable control to pin tenant data to specific geographic regions for hosted API traffic, plus an automated way to produce time-bound evidence bundles (retention policy, region routing logs, attestations) for audits. Existing region pin capabilities are fragmented across routing configs, tenant policies, and manual evidence exports.

Goal: Ship a Regional Residency Orchestrator for Hosted API that provides: 1) a clear operator/API for tenant-level region locks and soft-region-affinity, 2) retention defaults tied to residency policies, 3) an automated evidence-packaging process that bundles routing logs, policy snapshots, consent/attestation records, and exportable audit artifacts on demand or scheduled, and 4) console and API surfaces for operators and customers to manage/rescind locks and request evidence.

Scope: Hosted API only (not Dedicated/Private). Implementation will include API schema changes, Console flows, background evidence exporter service, and lightweight migration tooling to move noncompliant historical prefixes to compliant storage/retention pathways.

Out of scope: Deep integration into billing, Dedicated capacity work, and full on-prem export tooling for initial rollout.
acceptance_criteria: Tenant can set a residency lock via API or Console that results in all new request payloads being routed to allowed regions only
Retention policy can be configured per tenant and is attached to the residency lock (default 90/365-day options and custom), enforced for exported evidence
Evidence package can be generated on-demand and scheduled monthly; package contains routing logs, policy snapshot, KMS key metadata, and signed attestation linked to a tenant ID
Operators can view residency lock state, change history, and scheduled evidence jobs in Console with RBAC controls
Automated tests that simulate cross-region fallbacks and verify that residency-locked tenants never leave allowed regions during normal routing and during fallback
Documentation updated: API reference, Console UI guide, runbook for on-call support, and sample audit report template
activities: 2025-03-02 - Kickoff with Compliance, Platform, and DevEx. Agreed success metrics and MVP scope.
2025-03-04 - Architecture review: decided on a central 'residency-orchestrator' microservice that consumes tenant policy and publishes routing predicates to the Smart Router.
2025-03-06 - UX design session: Console will have a 'Residency' tab under Tenant settings. Draft wireframes linked in attachments.
2025-03-07 - Trade-off: full historical backfill is costly. Decided MVP will create evidence bundles for new logs and include a targeted archival export job for requested date ranges.
2025-03-09 - Security review pre-check: KMS metadata must be included in evidence bundle; toggled security_review_required flag.
2025-03-11 - Engineering spike results: estimated 6 dev sprints including integration tests and export pipeline. Identified work to coordinate with routing team for atomic policy rollout.
2025-03-12 - PM sync: agreed on release gate criteria and customer beta list (3 tenants). Moving ticket to Planned and assigning to Marco Ruiz.
